description: This file implements basic operations for a binary search tree, including search, insert, in-order traversal (infix walk), and freeing memory. It defines functions for managing tree nodes in a data structure context.

methods.name: struct:tree_node * tree_search(struct tree_node * tree,void * key,int (* compare)(const void *,const void *))
methods.description: Recursively searches for a node with a given key in the binary search tree.

methods.name: struct:tree_node * tree_insert(struct tree_node ** rootp,void * key,int (* compare)(const void *,const void *))
methods.description: Inserts a new node with the specified key into the binary search tree, creating a new node if necessary.

methods.name: void infix_walk(struct tree_node * t,void (* action)(void * arg,void * key),void * arg)
methods.description: Performs an in-order traversal of the tree, executing a user-defined action on each node's key.

methods.name: void tree_free(struct tree_node * t)
methods.description: Recursively frees all nodes in the binary search tree.
